sections.reference_html:
Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use BusinessKit offline?

Yes! All data is stored locally first in SQLite and automatically syncs to Turso cloud when connected.

How do I import existing product & customer data?

You can import CSV files directly, or have the AI Copilot parse your vendor purchase invoices automatically.

Is my financial data secure?

All sensitive credentials and database tokens are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM.

rules: Call component_create first with html, css, and name.
HTML elements must include contenteditable="true" and data-field="..." for inline Visual Builder editing.
